# Select File

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Select a file or folder from the system.

## Syntax

~~~~text
selectFile(type: <#Enumeration (WFPickingMode) (Optional)#>, multiple: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
selectFile(type: Files, multiple: false)
~~~~
